professionalSummary.text: Configured putaway and pick-face rules in a WMS training instance for a new handheld scanning workflow covering three temperature zones and two pick-face sizes.
professionalSummary.witness: set up putaway and pick-face rules in the WMS training instance for a new handheld scanning workflow, covering three temperature zones and two pick-face sizes.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote 14 illustrated work instructions for receiving, putaway and replenishment on handheld scanners, each with photographs of scanner screens and exception steps.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote 14 illustrated work instructions for receiving, putaway and replenishment on the handheld scanners, each with photographs of the scanner screens and the exception steps.

professionalSummary.text: Trained 40 warehouse operatives over two weeks of half-day sessions in a training warehouse with dummy cartons, keeping attendance records.
professionalSummary.witness: Trained 40 operatives over two weeks of half-day sessions in the training warehouse, a mocked-up aisle stocked with dummy cartons, keeping attendance records for each session.

professionalSummary.text: Registered 60 handheld scanners with the IT service desk, checking device enrolment and app version before issue, and maintained the device register.
professionalSummary.witness: Registered 60 handheld scanners with the IT service desk, checking each device's enrolment and app version before issue, and kept the device register up to date.

experienceHighlights.text: Led rehearsal nights in the training instance for a handheld scanning workflow, identifying scan errors and resolving them before cut-over.
experienceHighlights.witness: Work sample: the report from two rehearsal nights in the training instance, listing the scripted scenarios, the scan errors found and the fixes applied, with a cover note listing the open actions to close before a cut-over date could be set, including a missing label printer and two unresolved scan errors.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported the handheld scanning rollout at Daventry site, with the new workflow live on every shift since spring, eliminating paper pick lists.
experienceHighlights.witness: Handheld scanning rollout at the Daventry site: per the client's account director, the new workflow 'has been live on every shift since the spring', with no paper pick lists left.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Report from two rehearsal nights in the training instance, documenting scan errors, fixes, and open actions for cut-over.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the report from two rehearsal nights in the training instance, listing the scripted scenarios, the scan errors found and the fixes applied, with a cover note listing the open actions to close before a cut-over date could be set, including a missing label printer and two unresolved scan errors.

skills.witness: set up putaway and pick-face rules in the WMS training instance for a new handheld scanning workflow, covering three temperature zones and two pick-face sizes.
Wrote 14 illustrated work instructions for receiving, putaway and replenishment on the handheld scanners, each with photographs of the scanner screens and the exception steps.
Trained 40 operatives over two weeks of half-day sessions in the training warehouse, a mocked-up aisle stocked with dummy cartons, keeping attendance records for each session.
Registered 60 handheld scanners with the IT service desk, checking each device's enrolment and app version before issue, and kept the device register up to date.
